description: MainActivity.java defines the main entry point for an Android Snake game. It sets up the user interface including score display, controls, sound management, and game lifecycle handling. The class manages interactions with the SnakeGameView component, handles user inputs (touch buttons for directions), manages sound effects, and shows dialogs for game over and settings.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity is the primary activity initializing the Snake game UI, controls, sound, and game event handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI elements, game view, controls, sound, and listeners.

methods.name: showGameOverDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog when the game ends, showing the final score and options to restart or exit.

methods.name: showSettingsDialog
methods.description: Displays settings dialog to toggle sound options.

methods.name: makeArrowButton
methods.description: Creates a direction arrow button with a given drawable resource.

methods.name: dp
methods.description: Converts device-independent pixels to actual pixels.

methods.name: initSound
methods.description: Initializes sound effects and loads audio resources.

methods.name: playEat
methods.description: Plays the sound effect for eating.

methods.name: playGameOver
methods.description: Plays the game over sound effect.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases sound resources when activity is destroyed.
